title: Has anybody else here lucid dreamed in order to be at mallworld?
content: I’ve had many nights where I was in the mood of going to mallworld, and so I would dream in order to get there, but it got to the point where I preferred being in mallworld instead of “real life”. I have now accepted to not rely on escaping to mallworld, because i had to learn to be okay with “real life” in peace.
